item.title: Free Colon Cancer Screening Available to Area Residents
item.description: The American Cancer Society designates March as Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month. In observance, Texas County Memorial Hospital (TCMH) is offering free colorectal cancer screening kits to area residents. Individuals may contact TCMH to request a free colon cancer screening kit through Friday, March 27.
